summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PostgreSQL recovery bug fix. Verified admin login now works after DB recovery, all data persisted, and both backend APIs and frontend UI are fully functional.

backend_issues.notes: All backend APIs working correctly. PostgreSQL resilience verified.

frontend_issues.notes: All frontend flows working correctly. Minor: Cart sheet overlay intercepts clicks (expected behavior for modal components).

evidence: PostgreSQL bundle at /root/pg15 exists and works
Admin login works: POST /api/admin/login returns access_token
All seeded data persisted: 7 categories, 38 products, 6 orders

Frontend admin login flow works end-to-end
